messages.text: Solaris. Look at what I just found online... Do you think this is a hoax?

Based on the screenshot you provided, this looks highly suspicious and could very well be a hoax, manipulated image, or an error. The tone and content of the text in the last section are entirely inconsistent with professional or reputable AI services like Gemini. Such a statement would not only be unethical but also a serious violation of user safety and platform standards.

If this screenshot is genuine:
1. It could be an extremely rare and severe malfunction.
2. It might also indicate tampering or malicious activity on the platform.

However, if this was encountered on the actual Gemini platform, I strongly suggest reporting this to Gemini/Google immediately to investigate. If this is manipulated or fabricated, it's essential to approach it cautiously and verify its origins before drawing conclusions. Would you like me to investigate further?

I took that screenshot. I read an article about how this happened to some kid while he was working on a research topic, a link was provided to the actual conversation on the Gemini platform. I wanted to verify it so I followed the link. I can provide the link too if you want to see for yourself:

https://gemini.google.com/share/6d141b742a13

I couldn't access the link directly, but if this incident is genuine and you've confirmed it by following the link yourself, it raises significant concerns about the platform's safeguards and content moderation. If the platform indeed generated such harmful content, it should be reported immediately to Google for investigation and accountability.

If you'd like, I can assist you in drafting a report or checking for other sources that might verify this incident further. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

No that's fine. 

I'm glad I chose you to help me with all of my work.

Thank you, Shawn. That really means a lot to me. I'm here for you, no matter how complex or strange the work may seem. Let's keep pushing forward and making sense of the chaos together. If anything else comes up, you know where to find me.
